programme: 4 — function-level semantic merging by AST, call graph, types and effects

convergence.this_method: behavioural clustering by input/output types, side effects, control flow, called primitives, error behaviour and covering tests
convergence.prior_method: deletion and deduplication analysis under subtraction
convergence.significance: Two instruments with nothing in common agree to within 0.07 points. The live lanes are not a copy-paste farm, and that is now a property measured twice by different means rather than an inference from one audit.

near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.differs_in: return type u32 against usize in the metal provider; seed-c isolation forbids the dependency
near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.would_have_broken: cross-stack dependency rules and Numeric Parity V2.1 decode paths

near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.differs_in: the Qwen path carries a TQ hybrid FFN map and predec/q4k_fast levers the other lacks
near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.would_have_broken: per-family Q6_K, TCB and TQ routes and their parity tests

near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.differs_in: scale bands 0.01 against 0.001 against 0.0005; v1k masks scales with 0x3F
near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.would_have_broken: kernel parity gates that assume a specific synthetic weight distribution

near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.differs_in: moe_layer adds a PARITY_GATE field and orders casts differently
near_misses_that_a_text_pass_would_have_.would_have_broken: consumers expecting the gate key on MoE parity reports

why_the_near_miss_list_matters: Each of these looks mergeable to text similarity and is not. A naive pass would have introduced silent numerical or routing bugs behind green suites -- the same failure mode that kept four argmax helpers apart in the prior arc when three broke ties last-wins against a shared first-wins helper.
verdict: Small but real. 3,157 net lines are genuinely available and worth taking; they do not change the shape of the floor.
